incident.summary: A request to move the bottom answer label was implemented by changing only the SVG <text> y-coordinate, leaving the shell and icon in place. The visible label component did not move and internal padding was damaged.
incident.root_cause: The skill contract used ambiguous label_offset wording and did not define label as a whole visual unit: shell/border + icon + text + related connector anchors.
incident.correct_behavior: A label move changes row/node geometry so shell, icon, text, halo/glow, and connector anchors move together. Text-only changes require explicit text_baseline/internal-padding wording. Ambiguous label_offset manifests fail closed.

fail_before_fix.observed_pre_fix: Before the retained cases, the suite could reach READY while a human instruction 'move the answer label' was satisfied by text-only movement. After adding the guard, the retained cases verify shell+icon+text move together and ambiguous label_offset is rejected.
